articles.txt:
À un jour seulement de la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI , de nouvelles captures d’écran circulent sur les réseaux sociaux. Leur origine exacte reste incertaine, même si Tez, dataminer bien informé sur Rockstar, affirme qu’elles proviennent du système interne d’un site de tests. Insider Gaming a relayé cette affirmation en citant une conversation sur Discord. Six captures d’écran ont fait surface au total, dont deux particulièrement intéressantes.
Une image semble montrer Lucia tenant un homme en otage. Sur une autre, Jason et Lucia entrent dans un magasin où une femme armée semble être en plein braquage. Sur Reddit , les fans se demandent si GTA 6 ( disponible en précommande sur Amazon ) permettra aux joueurs d’utiliser des otages comme boucliers humains ou de tomber sur des crimes commis par des PNJ. Dans les deux cas, la question est de savoir si ces situations se limitent à des séquences scriptées au cours des missions ou si elles peuvent aussi se produire spontanément dans le monde ouvert. Sans surprise, de nombreux fans espèrent que ce sera le cas. Les deux captures d’écran sont visibles ci-dessous.

Les autres captures d’écran laissent moins de place aux spéculations, mais elles en dévoilent un peu plus sur l’univers de Grand Theft Auto VI , notamment de nouvelles coiffures pour les protagonistes et des armes encore jamais montrées. Une image particulièrement intéressante se déroule dans une salle de sport, où un homme chauve et musclé fait une flexion du biceps avec un haltère de 95 livres, tandis qu’une femme fait des tractions à l’arrière-plan. articles.txt:
As I prepare to pick up and play Grand Theft Auto VI tonight, I’m bracing myself to be in Leonida pretty much non-stop for days, weeks, maybe even months. It just intuitively feels like it’s going to be a doozy of a long game, huh?
After all its predecessor, GTA V, takes 32 hours just to rush through the main story (according to HowLongToBeat), and over 50 if you factor in side content. I’d expect its successor, especially with all the bells and whistles Rockstar is showing off, to take even longer.
With reviews out today, we now have a rough idea of what to expect, and yeah: this game’s gonna take time.
Our own reviewer , Zack, says he saw the credits roll at about 90 hours of gameplay. Granted, he was doing a lot of side content and wandering around and testing stuff, and not everyone will want to be anywhere near as thorough as he was. Zack suggests a speedier player might make it through in around 60 hours. Jeff Gerstmann, in his review , says he beat the game after about 45 hours, maybe 50 if you count some saves he had to reload throughout. Zack doesn’t think you can reasonably finish the story in much less than that.
For those looking for more to do, though, Zack has spent 150 hours in GTA VI and still hasn’t seen everything there is to see or done everything there is to do. Like past Rockstar games, GTA VI will let you keep playing after the credits roll (though in a slightly unusual way) , so you’re free to turn Leonida inside out for days on end if that’s what you want to do.
Sorry to all the other games in my backlog, we might be here a while.

articles.t: GTA 6’s sex & violence is crashing into China’s censorship rules
articles.chapeau: GTA VI is built on sex, violence and crime. China’s censorship rules could dramatically reshape how the game is streamed and promoted.

0 Share Newsweek is a Trust Project member See more of our trusted coverage when you search. Prefer Newsweek on Google to see more of our trusted coverage when you search. The upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI game is built around crime, violence and adult content. But gamers in China who want to livestream their play could face an unusual restriction—no stealing cars.
Carjacking is one of, if not the only, features reportedly captured by China’s extensive online-content controls. An unverified document of guidance for GTA VI streamers on Douyin, Beijing's version of TikTok, has been widely circulated on Chinese blogs and tech sites.
The document reportedly asks streamers to restrict attacks on civilians and police and the display of red blood—which aligns with existing platform rules controlling graphic violence and sexualized content.
But this guidance could not even matter. GTA VI does not have approval for official sale in mainland China, so it will be much harder for gamers to get their hands on the hotly anticipated title.
Official video game streaming guidelines from China’s National Radio and Television Administration also say gamers should not stream games that have not been approved for official sale.
So what happens when one of gaming's most deliberately adult franchises meets one of the world's most tightly controlled online environments?
No. But it has not been approved for official mainland release either. China’s imported games require regulatory approval for official distribution—something that the GTA franchise has never had.
Despite this, playing GTA is not banned; rather, fans access the game through a large gray market. Gamers are forced to obtain the game from other markets such as Hong Kong—something authorities generally ignore.
While the game may not have official approval, makers of GTA VI Rockstar Games have not been deterred in promoting the release to the Chinese market.
In recent days, Rockstar Games started its own verified account on Douyin, the Chinese alternative to TikTok.
With over 480,000 followers, the account’s only post is a promotion of the game. It reads: "Preload GTA VI now. Grand Theft Auto VI is now available for preloading. Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S."
Newsweek reached out to Rockstar Games via email for comment and is awaiting a reply.
Gamers may be able to play the game with workarounds. But, when it comes to streaming the content, there are more guardrails.
China’s 2022 video game livestreaming rules say that online platforms should not provide livestreams of games that have not received approval from the relevant authorities.
Douyin’s own content terms and conditions also prohibit users from, "deliberately displaying various kinds of bloody/graphic imagery, including serious traffic-accident scenes, bloody/violent games, and murder scenes."
Meanwhile, reports from Gamersky. 3DM Game and others have claimed that a document titled "Guidelines for Compliance During Livestreams of GTA 6” has been leaked by a Douyin creator. The guideline claims include rules that GTA VI streamers cannot steal cars, attack civilians, or fight police officers while streaming content.
There were also claims that the document asked streamers to avoid revealing clothing and sharing bloody scenes.
Newsweek reached out to Douyin via email for comment and confirmation of the guidelines and is waiting for a response.
As potential rules around what can and cannot be shared on social media around GTA VI continue to swirl, the game has already been censored in the run-up to its release.
In August, a 27-minute extended look at GTA VI was released on Netflix in the U.S. This included gameplay footage that featured the protagonists Jason and Lucia in a fight with gang members, at a nightclub and driving around the city.
But, when this preview was shared with Chinese audiences on social platform Bilibili, it was substantially censored. The nightclub and dancing footage was heavily blurred, and scenes involving smoking and bikini-clad characters obscured.
Adjusting violent games or broadcasts for Chinese audiences is not unusual. Changes can range from removing blood and corpses to reframing a game’s entire premise.
One of the clearest examples was in the PUBG Mobile game. After maker Tencent failed to obtain permission to monetize the game in mainland China, they replaced the test version with the approved Game for Peace ; this was an anti-terrorism themed alt

articles.t: « GTA 6 », un développement XXL entaché par les polémiques
articles.chapeau: Derrière la hype de « GTA 6 », le jeu a été terni par un développement marqué par des piratages historiques, des accusations de management toxique, des licenciements controversés et des tensions sociales au sein de Rockstar Games
articles.txt:
C’était loin d’être un long fleuve tranquille. Grand Theft Auto VI , disponible ce jeudi 19 novembre, est déjà l’un des plus grands événements de l’histoire du jeu vidéo . Mais derrière la hype du jeu, les coulisses de son développement sont loin d’être aussi spectaculaires que les bandes-annonces le laissent imaginer. Depuis plusieurs années, Rockstar Games a fait face à une succession de controverses qui touchent aussi bien ses méthodes de travail que sa gestion des équipes et la sécurité de ses productions.
Malgré des ambitions XXL pour la production artistique la plus coûteuse de l’histoire, le développeur a subi une pression considérable pour livrer le jeu le plus attendu de sa génération.
Derrière les ambitions de GTA 6 , la gestion des équipes de Rockstar est régulièrement pointée du doigt. Les premières critiques remontent à 2018, lorsque Dan Houser, cofondateur du studio, évoque des semaines de travail pouvant atteindre 100 heures pour certaines équipes. Cette culture du « crunch », caractérisée par des périodes de travail intensif, alimente les accusations de pression excessive et de management toxique. Rockstar a alors promis de changer ses méthodes pour GTA 6 , notamment en limitant les heures supplémentaires et les comportements managériaux abusifs. Mais les tensions persistent.
La crise atteint son paroxysme en octobre 2025, lorsque 34 employés sont licenciés au Royaume-Uni et au Canada. Le studio justifie ces licenciements par la divulgation d’informations confidentielles sur Discord, tandis que le syndicat professionnel Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain dénonce une répression antisyndicale. En 2026, 23 anciens salariés contestent leur licenciement devant la justice britannique. À ces tensions s’ajoutent des témoignages sur le manque de transparence des primes, les inégalités salariales et la pression liée aux heures supplémentaires. Autant de controverses qui fragilisent l’image d’un studio pourtant déterminé à améliorer sa culture interne.
Rockstar Games a également été confronté à plusieurs crises pendant le développement de GTA 6 , entre fuites massives et reports successifs. La plus spectaculaire survient en septembre 2022, lorsqu’un pirate informatique parvient à accéder aux données internes du studio. Des dizaines de vidéos du jeu encore en développement sont dérobées puis diffusées sur Internet. Les images dévoilent notamment des séquences de gameplay, les personnages de Jason et Lucia ainsi que plusieurs environnements de Vice City. En 2024, pour éviter qu’un tel incident se reproduise, le studio renforce ses mesures de sécurité et impose notamment le retour au bureau de ses salariés.
Pourtant, en août 2026, de nouvelles informations confidentielles liées au jeu circulent sur Internet. À ces problèmes s’ajoutent plusieurs reports de sortie. Initialement attendu en 2025, GTA 6 est d’abord reporté au 26 mai 2026, puis au 19 novembre 2026. Rockstar justifie ces décisions par la nécessité de disposer de davantage de temps pour peaufiner le jeu et atteindre le niveau de qualité attendu. Ces retards successifs ont alimenté la frustration des joueurs et les interrogations sur les difficultés rencontrées par le studio. Mais finalement, le jeu arrive bien sur nos consoles, et il risque bien de faire parler de lui pendant un long moment.

articles.chapeau: Plus: why does the base PS5 version not use QSSR?
articles.txt:
A common question we've seen online in the wake of GTA 6 reviews going live is the conundrum over the Xbox Series X. The game renders at an internal resolution of 1440p, with an in-house TAA upscale to 4K. Why didn't Rockstar use the recently-released FSR 4 AI upscaler instead, as they did on Xbox Series S? Come to think of it, why didn't they use Sony's QSSR on base PS5 too?
Let's tackle the Series X question first. Here, the answer may be hiding in plain sight - after all, Microsoft published the critical FSR 4 stats for Xbox developers just earlier this month. And within those figures, you can see that the frame-time cost of FSR 4, both the full-fat (3.86ms) and lite (2.75ms) versions, is likely to be significantly higher than the cost of Rockstar's in-house TAA.
You'd have to get a huge visual return on investment to make that ~4ms cost for full-fat FSR 4 or ~3ms cost for FSR 4 Lite worthwhile, and more likely you'd have to drop the game's internal resolution to compensate. For many games, that's not necessarily a bad trade to make, but GTA 6 is almost unique in its widespread use of ray-traced effects, which have been employed even on the lowest-end Series S version of the game - clearly, they're key to the look that Rockstar is going for. When internal resolution drops, the quality of those effects can suffer greatly, and that's likely why Rockstar stuck to their 1440p internal resolution with TAA.
On the Xbox Series S, it's a different story. The game renders at 720p and outputs at 1080p, so we have a different set of costs for FSR 4. Microsoft's figures have full-fat FSR 4 at 2.9ms and FSR 4 Lite at just 1.9ms, and clearly here the difference in visual fidelity was judged to be worth it - though Series S also has the hardest time sticking to its 30fps target, and frequently falls below it.
It's important to note that this is conjecture on our part - Rockstar has yet to explain exactly what prompted them to go down this route, and indeed only publicly revealed the Xbox Series X/S versions of the game as they went live in New Zealand today. However, based on our experience and these numbers, we think it's a pretty safe explanation.
The same logic can also be applied to the base PS5 release, which also sees a 1440p internal resolution upscaled to 4K using TAA. Why not use QSSR here, since it ought to deliver a better-looking image that gets closer to PSSR levels of quality? Once again, the frame-time cost is likely too high to fit into the budget - we saw QSSR cost around 4.4ms more than Insomniac's in-house upscaling solution in Marvel's Wolverine when targeting a 4K output, for instance. If it was a similar differential in GTA 6, then sticking to the cheaper TAA solution would again make a lot of sense.
What do you think of this explanation? And what more would you like to know about GTA 6 in each of its four console versions? Let me know in the comments below - and be sure to read our GTA 6 console comparisons and full tech review if you haven't already!

articles.txt:
Alors que le jeu ne sera disponible que le 19 novembre, "GTA 6" figure bien parmi les titres nommés lors des prochains Game Awards, récompensant les meilleurs jeux de l'année. Une annonce qui a fait grand bruit dans l'industrie et auprès des joueurs alors que le titan de Rockstar Games peut même repartir avec huit trophées. L'annonce n'avait rien de surprenant. Et pourtant, elle en a surpris certains. GTA VI sera bien en lice pour être élu Jeu de l'année 2026, lors de la prochaine cérémonie des Game Awards , le 10 décembre prochain à Los Angeles. Le nouveau jeu de Rockstar Games est même nommé dans huit catégories (Jeu de l'année, Meilleure réalisation, Meilleure direction artistique, Meilleure musique, Meilleure narration, Meilleur son, Meilleure interprétation pour Manni L. Perez (Lucia), Meilleur jeu Action/aventure).
Comment un jeu pas encore disponible pour les joueurs peut-il concourir? Par le jeu des organisations de remise de prix. Pour cette promotion 2026, les Game Awards ont rendu éligible pour la centaine de jurés du monde entier tous les jeux mis en vente avant le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 inclus. À quelques jours près, la date de clôture se situe toujours autour de la mi-novembre. L'an dernier, la date limite de commercialisation avait été fixée au 21 novembre. Les jeux sortis en décembre 2025 pouvaient également être considérés.
Pour le vote du public (Player's Voice) qui ouvre généralement fin novembre, les jeux doivent avoir été reçus avant le 30 novembre. Dans les deux cas de figure, GTA VI peut donc légitimement être soumis par les différents médias du jury.
Par ailleurs, comme la publication des différents tests à travers le monde l'a montré, le jeu a pu être testé plusieurs semaines avant sa sortie par des membres du jury des Game Awards ainsi que par des médias faisant partie du panel Metacritic.
Lucia et Jason, les deux héros de "GTA 6" © Rockstar Games Il aurait donc été compliqué de repousser GTA VI aux votes de l'année suivante, alors qu'il sera entre les mains des joueurs au moment de la cérémonie. Difficile d'imaginer les équipes de Rockstar Games recevoir le prix de "Jeu le plus attendu de 2027" - pour la 3e année de rang! - si cela avait été la seule catégorie dans laquelle il pouvait alors concourir.
Les Game Awards sont décernés par un panel de médias et créateurs de contenus qui ont, de manière récurrente comme BFM Tech, un accès anticipé à plusieurs jeux, mais pas forcément à tous. GTA VI n'était ainsi pas le seul à pouvoir concourir avant sa sortie et tous ceux qui arrivaient courant novembre et décembre pouvaient se positionner, mais il est sans doute le plus lointain dans le calendrier de l'année à figurer parmi les nommés. Rayman Legends Retold qui sort le 3 décembre bascule l'an prochain.
Enfin, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time n'est arrivé dans certaines rédactions que le 5 novembre, jour de sa sortie, au moment où il fallait faire des choix pour le vote. Cela ne l'empêche pas non plus, dix jours plus tard, de concourir dans quatre catégories (Jeu de l'année, Meilleure direction artistique, Meilleure musique, Meilleur jeu action/aventure).

How are people playing GTA 6 already? The New Zealand trick and early access explained
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 does not officially launch in the United States until Thursday, November 19, but social media platforms are already flooded with live gameplay. From the classic "New Zealand time-zone trick" on Xbox to early review copies and high-profile influencer streams, here is exactly how thousands of players are exploring Vice City hours before the local midnight release.
articles.txt:
If you have logged onto X, Twitch, or YouTube today, you have likely seen massive amounts of unedited Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay . While the official US release date is set for Thursday, November 19 , the game is already out in the wild.
Because Rockstar Games opted for a "rolling regional midnight launch" —meaning the game unlocks locally at exactly 12:00 AM in every individual time zone —the rollout has already begun on the other side of the planet.
Here is a breakdown of how people are already playing GTA 6 and why your feed is full of Vice City content hours before your local launch.
The primary reason everyday gamers are already playing is due to a geographical reality: New Zealand experiences midnight before the rest of the world . By exploiting this time zone difference, players in the US and Europe are tricking their consoles into unlocking the game early .
Not everyone playing today is using a geographic loophole. Rockstar Games provided early access to two specific groups:
If you are waiting for your local midnight launch to jump in, be prepared for a massive download.
The game requires up to 212 GB of available storage space on both the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S . If you have not pre-loaded the game yet, you will need to clear significant hard drive space before the midnight launch.
Additionally, GTA 6 is currently only available on current-generation consoles . The standard edition is priced at $79.99, while the Ultimate version runs $99.99. PC players are entirely left out of the current launch window, as Rockstar has not yet confirmed an official release date for the PC port.

articles.txt:
The Chamber 106.6 is hosted by Slayer guitarist Kerry King and Slayer vocalist and bassist Tom Araya.
The station promises decades of metal, and its first three preview tracks immediately establish the direction: Black Sabbath, Pantera and Slayer.
Rockstar appears to be treating The Chamber as a genuine metal station rather than a general rock playlist with occasional heavy songs.
Putting them together behind the fictional radio desk immediately gives the station a distinct personality.
Grand Theft Auto radio hosts are usually more entertaining when they have an attitude rather than behaving like neutral playlist announcers.
Two members of Slayer discussing metal while the player causes chaos around Leonida sounds like something designed specifically for GTA.
That alone makes it a more interesting choice than simply picking one of the band’s most obvious hits.
Instead, the preview reaches into a later part of the catalogue.
That suggests The Chamber may reward serious metal listeners rather than simply replaying the ten songs everybody already knows.
“I’m Broken” combines an enormous guitar riff with the groove-metal style the band helped define.
It is extremely easy to imagine the track playing during a high-speed GTA chase.
Some songs become better inside GTA because the player is moving through the world while hearing them.
Its appearance also creates a direct relationship between the DJs and the playlist.
Players are not merely hearing Kerry King and Tom Araya talk about metal.
Early players in release regions have started mentioning additional tracks including songs by Mastodon, Anthrax, Metallica and Megadeth.
Those reports are extremely plausible given the station’s format, but Radar should keep an explicit distinction between confirmed preview songs and early community discoveries until each track can be independently verified.
Early player discussion suggests additional rock programming may exist beyond The Chamber.
That would make sense because Rockstar said the six pre-release stations were previews of a broader radio selection rather than necessarily the complete lineup.
Any additional rock station should be treated separately once verified.
But Grand Theft Auto has historically been strongest when its stations also teach players about a genre.
Twenty minutes later they may have discovered a Black Sabbath album they have never heard.
The radio becomes a music recommendation engine embedded inside the game.
For a completely different side of the game’s music, Radar explains the Justice track used in GTA VI’s launch trailer .
The three confirmed preview tracks are Black Sabbath’s “I”, Pantera’s “I’m Broken” and Slayer’s “Raining Blood”.
If early player reports are representative of the final playlist, The Chamber could become one of GTA’s strongest rock and metal stations.

articles.t: British hackers face prison for GTA 6 data breach and crypto thefts | TechCrunch
articles.chapeau: Two British hackers face lengthy prison sentences for hacks that broke into the Grand Theft Auto gamemaker and for stealing millions in crypto.
articles.txt:
British hackers face prison for GTA 6 data breach and crypto thefts Zack Whittaker 6:55 AM PST · November 18, 2026 Two British hackers are facing lengthy prison sentences for separate hacks as part of their roles in long-running, prolific cybercriminal hacking groups. The two are accused of hacks that stole millions of dollars in cryptocurrency and leaked pre-release footage from Grand Theft Auto VI.
Tyler Buchanan, 24, from Dundee, Scotland, has been sentenced to six years by a U.S. court after he was extradited to the United States in 2025. Buchanan was accused of stealing at least $11 million in cryptocurrency from dozens of companies as part of a phishing scheme. The attacks would impersonate IT helpdesks and call up unsuspecting employees and trick them into giving over their credentials, which the hackers would use to break in and steal cryptocurrency.
Meanwhile, Arion Kurtaj, 21, from Oxford, England, has pleaded guilty to several cyberattacks that he carried out while a teenager. One hack included the theft of data and extortion of Rockstar Games, the maker of Grand Theft Auto VI, which was released Wednesday after several delays .
Kurtaj was previously ordered by a U.K. court to be detained indefinitely after deeming him unable to stand trial due to his autism diagnosis and his perceived high hacking risk to the public. But U.K. authorities, tasked with charging Kurtaj with cybercrime offenses, confirmed Monday that he had admitted to several hacks, including leaking footage of the long-awaited video game, and would subsequently face a public trial.
U.K. authorities confirmed earlier reporting that Kurtaj hacked several companies, including while he was confined to a hotel amid police protection from rival criminal gangs. The authorities said Kurtaj used an Amazon Fire TV stick to hack the companies, which breached his bail conditions.
Both Buchanan and Kurtaj were members of overlapping cybercriminal groups, dubbed 0ktapus, Lapsus$, and later Scattered Spider . These prolific hacking gangs mostly consist of teenagers and young male adults, lending to the term “advanced persistent teenagers,” whose focus and motivations were to steal as much money as possible through various cyberattacks.
Over the years, the hackers were collectively responsible for hundreds of cyberattacks targeting big companies, including Coinbase , DoorDash , Mailchimp , and Nvidia .
By late 2024, both U.K. and U.S. authorities say they had indicted five of the hackers whom they believed were key members of the hacking groups, including Buchanan. The U.S. Department of Justice said this week that Buchanan is the fifth and final defendant to be sentenced in this case.

Quand les « pires » notes attribuées à un jeu vidéo sont des 8 et des 9 sur 10, on comprend vite que GTA 6 est en train d’ écraser la concurrence . Pourtant, au milieu du concert de louanges qui accompagne la sortie du titre ce jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S, les critiques de PlayStation LifeStyle et de ScreenHub ont le mérite de pointer du doigt les limites bien réelles du jeu de Rockstar. Leurs reproches portent sur la fluidité, le rythme du début de partie et l’obligation d’entretenir physiquement les personnages.
Sortie GTA 6 : les premiers joueurs arrivent dans Leonida (infos, images et premières astuces en direct) 1. Le plafond technique des 30 images par seconde (et l’absence de mode Performance) C’est le principal reproche formulé par PlayStation LifeStyle, qui qualifie pourtant le jeu de « titre le plus ambitieux techniquement jamais créé » avant de lui retirer un point pour sa fluidité. Sur PS5, GTA 6 vise 30 images par seconde (avec des baisses à 20 FPS), sans mode Performance à 60 images par seconde. Le testeur a joué sur une PS5 classique, mais précise que la PS5 Pro est elle aussi limitée à 30 images par seconde avec des
Pire encore, le nombre d’images par seconde chute régulièrement dans certaines zones très denses de la carte, au point que le journaliste avoue avoir fini par éviter certains quartiers pour ne pas subir ces ralentissements. Pour un joueur habitué à 60 ou 120 images par seconde, l’adaptation prend du temps. Le testeur compare l’expérience au fait de « regarder la trilogie Le Seigneur des Anneaux sur un iPhone ». L’œuvre reste grandiose, mais le support ne lui rend pas justice. Il réserve son 10/10 à une future version PC ou PS6.
GTA 6 // Source : Rockstar Games 2. Un début de partie beaucoup trop lent et bavard De son côté, ScreenHub attaque le jeu sur un terrain bien plus sensible : le rythme et l’écriture de GTA 6. La journaliste confesse s’être « complètement ennuyée pendant les douze premières heures ». Loin du chaos immédiat et débridé attendu d’un GTA , le premier chapitre ressemble selon elle à un « simulateur de bon petit ami » très dirigiste, dans lequel Jason passe son temps à rendre service à Lucia pendant et après son passage en prison.
Selon le média australien, il faut attendre le chapitre 3 (soit environ 25 heures de jeu) pour que l’aventure s’ouvre vraiment et devienne amusante, et même 47 heures (au chapitre 4) pour avoir enfin l’impression de jouer l’histoire plutôt que de la regarder. ScreenHub pointe aussi une écriture inégale, visiblement écrite et réécrite par de nombreuses mains pendant des années. Le jeu hésite, selon la critique, entre la satire potache qui a fait la réputation de la licence et un drame social sérieux sur la pauvreté en Amérique, sans réussir ni l’un ni l’autre.
GTA 6 // Source : Rockstar Games 3. Des mécaniques de survie et de sport jugées pénibles Enfin, ScreenHub épingle une mécanique de gameplay de GTA 6 directement héritée de Red Dead Redemption 2 et GTA : San Andreas : l’obligation d’entretenir physiquement ses personnages. Pour garder Jason et Lucia en forme, endurants et musclés, le joueur doit régulièrement les nourrir et leur faire faire de l’exercice au quotidien (tractions, shakes protéinés, alimentation équilibrée).
Une contrainte jugée fastidieuse et peu gratifiante par la critique, qui avoue avoir détesté devoir s’occuper du régime alimentaire et des séances de musculation de Jason depuis son canapé . Ces reproches n’ont pas empêché les deux médias de saluer l’État de Leonida, le duo formé par Jason et Lucia et le niveau de détail du monde ouvert .

articles.txt:
Back Country Radio brings outlaw country and classic American songwriting to the rural areas of Leonida, hosted by Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey.
A third personality, Mud Dog Mike, checks in from an airboat as the station’s roving reporter and “swamp meteorologist”.
The early playlist suggests Rockstar is going much deeper than contemporary chart country.
These are preview selections rather than the full final tracklist.
Additional songs have been reported by GTA soundtrack databases, but Radar should separate verified in-game music from pre-release reporting until the complete station is available.
The combination is one of GTA VI’s strangest and most interesting radio ideas.
Wallen is one of the biggest modern country performers in America.
Lana Del Rey is primarily associated with alternative pop, cinematic Americana and melancholic songwriting.
Put them together on a station playing outlaw and classic country and the result feels extremely Rockstar.
Country music has always been present around the edges of Lana Del Rey’s work.
Her songs frequently use American-road imagery, small towns, cars, bars, nostalgia and faded glamour.
But the cultural world surrounding it often overlaps with country songwriting.
A fictional rural Florida station allows Rockstar to use that personality without pretending Lana is suddenly a traditional Nashville performer.
The title alone sounds like something designed for Grand Theft Auto.
David Allan Coe became associated with outlaw country, a movement that pushed against the polished Nashville mainstream.
His music could be confrontational, funny and deliberately difficult.
“Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior” fits GTA’s rural world because it sounds like music that belongs to characters living outside conventional expectations.
Loretta Lynn was one of country music’s most important songwriters and singers.
Her work frequently addressed relationships from a direct female perspective.
“Don’t Come Home A-Drinkin’ (With Lovin’ on Your Mind)” tells an unreliable partner exactly what she thinks of his behaviour.
Putting it beside outlaw-country recordings immediately gives Back Country Radio more depth than a playlist of modern stadium-country hits.
This collaboration brings two enormous country personalities together.
Waylon Jennings became one of the defining figures of outlaw country.
Hank Williams Jr. developed his own identity while carrying one of country music’s most famous family names.
“The Conversation” revolves around another legendary musician: Hank Williams.
That gives players discovering it through GTA an immediate route backwards through country history.
Wallen has an original track called “Last Thing You Need” on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.
The 34-track album is separate from the licensed radio soundtrack.
The Album contains newly created music associated with GTA VI.
Wallen therefore participates in the game in more than one way.
Reports ahead of launch have linked Lana Del Rey to the wider GTA VI music project, while her role as Delta Dawne is already established.
The safest distinction is between her confirmed radio-hosting role and any individual songs.
Once the game and full album are available, those should be listed separately.
Rockstar specifically positions it around the rural areas of Leonida rather than central Vice City.
Back Country Radio should feel completely different when Jason or Lucia is travelling through swamps, small towns and highways away from the city.
For the wider radio lineup, Radar already has a guide to all six announced GTA VI stations: GTA 6 radio stations and hosts .
The confirmed preview includes David Allan Coe, Loretta Lynn and the collaboration between Hank Williams Jr. and Waylon Jennings.
Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey host the station as MW and Delta Dawne.
Expect the complete playlist to extend well beyond those three tracks after launch.

articles.txt:
Les joueurs sur PS5 doivent impérativement installer une mise à jour du logiciel système. Les utilisateurs Xbox peuvent, eux, déjà y jouer en changeant de fuseau horaire.
Une étape primordiale avant de pouvoir profiter du jeu. Les fans de Grand Theft Auto (GTA) vont devoir installer une mise à jour de leur PlayStation 5 en amont du lancement du sixième opus jeudi à minuit.
Dans un message publié ce mercredi sur ses réseaux sociaux, le support de la console de Sony, indique qu’une mise à jour du logiciel système « est requise avant de jouer » à GTA 6. « Les joueurs devraient télécharger cette mise à jour avant minuit le 19 novembre afin d’être prêts à jouer le jour du lancement, le 19 novembre », ajoute PlayStation. Cette mise à jour ne concerne que les utilisateurs de PS5.
Sony Interactive has issued a PS5 system software update that is required before playing Grand Theft Auto VI. Players should download this update prior to midnight on November 19 so that they’re ready to play on launch day, November 19.
Les joueurs sur Xbox, ayant prétéléchargé GTA 6 sur leur console, peuvent, déjà jouer au jeu depuis 12 heures (heure de Paris), s’ils ont changé le fuseau horaire de leur console pour se mettre à l’heure néo-zélandaise.
La sortie de GTA 6, présenté par le site spécialisé IGN France comme « le plus grand jeu de tous les temps » est prévue ce 19 novembre à minuit, dans chaque fuseau horaire. Après treize ans d’attente et plusieurs reports, les fans trépignent d’impatience, certains ayant même posé des congés pour l’occasion . Selon une étude Ipsos BVA, 24 % des amateurs de jeu vidéo français ont prévu d’y jouer.
Si Rockstar Games, le studio américain derrière GTA, n’a pas communiqué de chiffres de précommandes, celles-ci ont dépassé les 15 millions d’unités, selon le cabinet spécialisé Sensor Tower.
Elles auraient généré plus de 1,5 milliard de dollars (1,3 milliard d’euros) avant même sa sortie, pour un budget qui oscillerait entre 1 et 1,5 milliard de dollars (888 millions et 1,3 milliard d’euros) d’après les analystes, des montants inédits pour ce secteur.

articles.t: GTA 6 Review
articles.chapeau: Is Grand Theft Auto 6 worth the hype? We
articles.txt:
What does eight years and an estimated $1 billion get you? Well, GTA 6 .
In this long-anticipated crime sandbox, Rockstar has assembled the most technologically accomplished open world ever made, expanding on its groundbreaking work with Red Dead Redemption 2 .
But crucially, with its dual protagonists Jason and Lucia, it’s grown up a bit.
This is the franchise at its most mature, shedding the cartoonish cultural caricatures of GTA 5 without losing the biting social commentary the series is known for.
The fictional state of Leonida is undoubtedly the star here; a dense and gigantic urban sandbox populated by an unfathomable array of art assets.
Whether it’s the easy-living coastal island of Key Lento or the mean streets of Crosstown, Rockstar’s artistry is utterly unprecedented.
Zoom in and you’ll see insects attracted to discarded food wrappers; a single convenience store has more unique art assets than entire districts in other open world games. This is remarkable stuff, delivered at such a scale it’s going to leave other publishers with their heads in their hands.
It feels alive, too; a casual visit to a gas station saw me berated by a cyclist for my wayward driving (I told him to chill out), while a brief pause on the side-walk ended up with my car getting hijacked by a masked criminal.
In over 150 hours of play, I’m still discovering random events that add depth and character to the open world. And even when the scripting is pushed to the background, the way every NPC feels designed, with distinctive personality and unique body types, makes this package an unfathomable feat.
But while Leonida is the standout, Jason and Lucia are the vehicles that guide you through it.
Just like GTA 5, each character has their own individual life, but the game is at its best when it brings them together.
I’ve never seen romance made into a mechanic quite like this, aside from perhaps the handholding in ICO , which is repurposed here. (Complete with DualSense haptic feedback when the characters touch.)
Jason is a bit of a beige blank slate, but Lucia brings genuine “girl power” to the story without pandering or feeling insincere.
In fact, in contrast to past GTAs, the many women in this instalment feel much more believable; the game frequently flips expectations on their head, without it ever coming across as forced.
A secret twist revealed in the opening moments adds gravity to the couple’s situation and becomes the driving force behind the story, which takes the pair from pillar to post, fulfilling the whims of a ragtag roster of ne’er-do-wells.
The campaign does fall into cliche territory at times, as the pair bounce from one bad idea to another in order to fulfil their ultimate ambition, and it’s something the characters seem to acknowledge. (“When are we going to get to call our own shots?” Jason wearily ponders at one point.)
But the mission design remains inventive throughout, regularly adding bespoke mechanics and interactions to keep things fresh.
In one early mission, Jason indulges his inner- PowerWash Simulator , as he rinses down a boat while other characters commentate key plot points. I won’t spoil the best moments, but needless to say there are missions here that will be remembered for a long time.
There’s also a slate of optional pastimes running concurrently to the main campaign which add genuine variety to the sandbox.
I was most enamoured by Jason’s home entertainment setup, which includes a distinctly PS4 coded console that can be powered up. I’ll leave you to discover his selection of fully playable games.
But beyond that, the ability to go hunting or even play a round of golf means you can lose yourself in this sandbox for hours at a time, and never really tire of the activities available to you.
Some of the action sequences remind me of all-time classics like Uncharted 3 – fist-pumping, set-piece heavy rollercoaster rides that push Rockstar’s engine to its limits, all within the confines of a meticulously designed open world.
Controller response is vastly superior to the studio’s previous games, with the cover shooting system feeling much more natural and the aiming mechanics buoyed by a pretty fun “bullet time” mechanic.
However, the game does fall into the trap of introducing heavily armoured bullet sponge enemies towards its conclusion, as it runs out of ways to make human-on-human encounters interesting.
That said, I really appreciated the agency GTA 6 gives you over how you approach each situation; non

Le sixième opus de la célèbre franchise du studio Rockstar Games sera enfin jouable jeudi à minuit. Aux origines de ce mastodonte vidéoludique, une entreprise écossaise qui assume, dès la fin des années 90, de proposer un jeu prônant l'immoralité et axé sur la violence. Ce jeudi 19 novembre, à minuit, sortira enfin le jeu vidéo GTA 6 . Avant même sa sortie, le jeu est déjà un succès commercial. Il a enregistré 15 millions de précommandes dans le monde, un record historique. Et qui dit précommandes dit recettes : 1,5 milliard de dollars, c'est ce qu'a déjà généré GTA VI. De quoi permettre au jeu d'être pratiquement à l'équilibre financier avant même sa commercialisation. Bref, les conditions du triomphe sont réunies.
Chevallier remonte le temps : Aux origines de GTA, une provocation assumée - 18/11 3:05 Rockstar Games, un studio écossais Et pourtant, au départ, rien ne prédestinait ce jeu au succès. Pour remonter aux origines de GTA, ce n'est pas aux États-Unis qu'il faut aller, mais en Écosse. Tout a commencé là-bas, dans les années 1990, à Dundee. Un petit studio développe alors un jeu de voitures en 2D. Rien de bien extraordinaire. Le projet devait s'appeler "Race n' Chase", soit "course et poursuite" en français.
Mais le concept évolue. Finalement, le jeu devient révolutionnaire : le joueur peut tout faire, ou presque. Aller n'importe où, agresser qui il veut, tirer sur n'importe quel passant. Et surtout, voler n'importe quelle voiture, au risque d'être pourchassé par la police. Bref, le concept consiste à vivre la vie d'un véritable voyou. D'où le titre final : "Grand Theft Auto". Dans le code pénal californien, cette expression désigne un vol de voiture aggravé.
Le côté subversif était donc assumé dès le début. ll va même devenir un argument de vente. En 1997, quelques mois avant la sortie du jeu, l'éditeur embauche une agence de communication pour en assurer la promotion. Et celle-ci va avoir une idée de génie : mettre en avant les aspects immoraux de GTA, du vol à la violence, en passant par les agressions contre la police. Le tout pour faire le buzz et s'arranger pour que des responsables politiques en entendent parler.
Et ça fonctionne... C'est un membre de la Chambre des lords, l'une des deux chambres du Parlement britannique, qui se saisit du dossier. Un vieux lord de 75 ans, très conservateur, qui interpelle le Premier ministre de l'époque, Tony Blair. Il réclame que le gouvernement interdise purement et simplement ce jeu scandaleux.
La demande n'aboutit pas, mais le buzz est assuré. Lorsque GTA sort, le 28 novembre 1997, il s'en vend un million d'exemplaires en moins d'un an. Vous voyez donc que les scandales liés à GTA et les reproches concernant la violence du jeu n'ont rien de nouveau. C'est même l'une des clés de son succès.

articles.t: GTA 6 : la Xbox Series S s'en remet à l'IA pour passer du 720p au 1080p — Frandroid
articles.chapeau: Sur Xbox Series S, GTA VI passe de 720p à 1080p avec FSR 4, l'upscaling par intelligence artificielle d'AMD, alors que la PS5 et la Xbox Series X utilisent
articles.txt:
Sur console, les gros jeux n’affichent presque jamais une image calculée directement en 4K. Ils la calculent dans une définition plus basse, puis l’agrandissent avec un algorithme d’upscaling, qui reconstruit les pixels manquants.
Rockstar a détaillé ses choix console par console dans une interview écrite publiée ce mercredi par le site Wccftech . Surprise : la console la moins puissante, la Xbox Series S , est la seule avec la PS5 Pro à avoir droit à un upscaling par intelligence artificielle. La PS5 et la Xbox Series X restent sur une méthode plus classique.
Trois responsables techniques de Rockstar ont signé la réponse, dont Jonathon Ashcroft, vice-président senior chargé de la technologie, et Chris Oat, directeur technique du moteur et des graphismes. Le studio vise 30 images par seconde sur toutes les consoles. Il a choisi pour chacune une définition de départ et une méthode d’agrandissement :
Pour aller plus loin Votre vieille Radeon et votre Xbox s’offrent une seconde jeunesse : AMD déploie le FSR 4.1 avec des mois d’avance
Sur le papier, toutes les consoles agrandissent l’image dans la même proportion : de 720p à 1080p comme de 1440p à 4K, elle grandit d’un facteur 1,5 en largeur et en hauteur. Par contre, la Series S part d’une image de 0,9 million de pixels, quatre fois moins que les 3,7 millions de la PS5 et de la Series X. Pour compenser, elle mise sur FSR 4, qui reconstruit l’image avec un réseau de neurones entraîné, alors que les TAA classiques et les anciennes versions de FSR appliquent des calculs fixes.
GTA VI serait donc le premier jeu Series S à utiliser FSR 4, avant même la Xbox Series X. La technologie est toute fraîche sur ces consoles, puisque AMD et Xbox ont annoncé l’arrivée de FSR 4.1 sur les Xbox Series le 20 octobre .
La Series S garde aussi l’illumination globale en ray tracing, qui simule la façon dont la lumière rebondit sur les surfaces pour éclairer une scène. D’après Rockstar, la mémoire limitée de la console a compliqué les choses, et les réglages de cet technologie d’éclairage changent d’une console à l’autre. Le studio tenait pourtant à la même solution partout, parce que tout le rendu du jeu repose sur une lumière calibrée d’après des sources réelles. Sur toutes les machines, l’interface est par superposition en 4K.
La PS5 standard a pourtant son propre upscaling par IA depuis quelques semaines. Sony a présenté le QSSR (Quick Spectral Super Resolution) le 1er octobre : il s’agit d’une version allégée du PSSR de la PS5 Pro, adaptée à la puce de la PS5 classique, qui n’a pas de circuits dédiés à l’IA. Marvel’s Wolverine et Ghost of Yōtei l’ont reçue en premier, et Sony la propose à tous les développeurs. GTA VI ne l’utilise pas pour l’instant : sur PS5, le jeu reste sur le TAA de Rockstar.
Rockstar explique avoir testé plusieurs approches sur chaque console avant de garder celle qui donnait le rendu et les performances voulus. La Series X a pourtant accès à FSR 4 au même titre que la Series S, et le studio l’a laissée sur son TAA, comme la PS5. GTA VI sort ce jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, à 30 images par seconde sur toutes les consoles, PS5 Pro comprise, sans mode performance.

articles.t: GTA 6 reviews award 99 Metacritic score, topping GTA 4 to become Rockstar's top-rated
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 Metacritic verdict is in, and reviews conclude it exceeds the loftiest expectations. On its release date, the title’s 99 Metascore beats Rockstar’s GTA 5, GTA 4, GTA 3, and Red Dead Redemption 2. It’s also tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the aggregator’s top game of all time.
articles.txt:
As leaked, the GTA 6 review embargo expired when the title unlocked in New Zealand at midnight local time. Scores quickly populated Metacritic , averaging 99 and making it Rockstar ’s highest-rated game ever. Critics praise the massive Leonida map while dismissing concerns about a lackluster story .
Currently, the aggregator shows exclusively positive scores. Players who survived the long buildup to launch must wait 36 hours following the GTA 6 release date to submit user ratings. Even so, journalists are impressed and have awarded it Universal Acclaim status.
Despite fears that Rockstar would limit access to avoid leaks , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was anxious to read GTA 6 reviews. As it turns out, more than 140 outlets received Xbox or PS5 codes in recent weeks. After boasting about the studio’s past performance, Zelnick will welcome the latest Metacritic consensus.
ⓘ screenshot, Metacritic GTA 6 Metacritic score shown Jason and Lucia ’s crime epic edges out GTA 4 , which notched an average score of 98 in 1999. GTA 5 , GTA 3 , and Red Dead Redemption 2 are closely behind at 97. The game has also tied the 1998 N64 classic Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic’s highest-rated entry of all time .
Much larger than previous open-world maps , Leonida lives up to its promise, according to reviews. Each region has a unique feel, enhanced by an overhauled dynamic weather system . More buildings are explorable, addressing a popular fan request.
The fictional take on Florida can test the limits of Xbox and PS5 consoles. Although frame rates target 30 fps , release date performance impressions are reassuring. Digital Foundry measured sporadic dips below that mark, but the visuals generally remain smooth. Most importantly, controls are responsive even when rendering at below 60 fps.
When avoiding side activities, some GTA 6 reviews clock the time to complete Jason and Lucia’s story at around 60 hours. The overwhelming amount of content can stall the narrative’s pacing at times. Nevertheless, without revealing spoilers, the writing is compelling with unexpected twists.
Minor quibbles include a Vice City that's overly congested with cars and NPCs , which can slow missions. Regardless, Take-Two and Rockstar will be happy with the record-setting 99 GTA 6 Metacritic rating.

articles.t: Sortie de GTA 6 : démarrage en prison, braquage et fuite, musique dingue… On a vu les premières images du jeu de l’année
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6, le jeu le plus attendu de l’année, voire de la décennie, est sorti à midi heure française en Nouvelle-Zélande. Donnant a
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6, le jeu le plus attendu de l’année, voire de la décennie, est sorti à midi heure française en Nouvelle-Zélande. Donnant aux joueurs les plus impatients les premières images.
Depuis des semaines, le monde du jeu vidéo n’attend que ça : ça y est, Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6 est enfin disponible, treize ans après le cinquième volet . Et les premiers chanceux à pouvoir y jouer sont les Néo-Zélandais, grâce au décalage horaire. Rockstar Games, l’éditeur du jeu, a en effet choisi de sortir son produit phare le jeudi 19 novembre à minuit heure locale de chaque pays. En France donc, les premières images et diffusions en direct sont accessibles depuis ce mercredi midi.
Une attente interminable et enfin les premières images, y compris venant de streamers français étant parvenus à mettre leur console à l’heure néo-zélandaise . Un premier chargement long, très long, laissant craindre à un bug. Puis des paramètres à configurer, reculant encore l’arrivée à Vice City, lieu où se déroule le jeu.
🚨BREAKING: GTA 6 Game intro officially released pic.twitter.com/UsX6ndby4n
D’entrée, le ton est donné : une première cinématique. Une voiture en train d’être volée et les deux protagonistes : Lucia et Jason. La police qui intervient, un premier coup de poing et des forces de l’ordre tabassées. Le tout avec une musique immersive, mais bloquée chez certains streamers pour des raisons de droits d’auteur. Bienvenue dans GTA 6. La scène suivante montre les deux protagonistes chez eux… en pleine embrouille.
Après de nombreux crédits, une nouvelle cinématique transporte le joueur dans la vie de Lucia, neuf mois avant les premières scènes. Puis un nouveau flash-back. Lucia est cette fois en prison, tenue orange typique des détenus américains sur le dos.
Officially GTA 6 GAMEPLAY ( Intro Prison Scene #GTA6 ) pic.twitter.com/4R7FMkitnI
C’est là que le jeu commence vraiment. Lucia est contrôlable dans un monde ouvert, typique des GTA aux graphiques qui semblent soignés malgré les 30 images par seconde. Fidèle aux attentes sur ce point.
L’ellipse narrative prend fin, retour dans un bar avec Lucia. Quelques secondes après, on la retrouve pistolet à la main en plein braquage d’un point de retrait d’argent. Le joueur reprend la main en pleine fuite, coursée par la police. La première séquence avec Jason survient pour sa part sur un bateau, suivie d’une première mission où le joueur est amené (très) largement à utiliser son arme à feu et à esquiver les balles.
HAHAHA il a réussi à rater le tuto de GTA 6 😭 pic.twitter.com/RelSWLyi5z
Sans grande surprise, les premiers instants de ce nouvel opus transportent le joueur directement dans ce qu’il attendait : l’intrigue, le cadre, les armes… En moins d’une heure, il aura contrôlé deux personnages, une voiture, un bateau et… un hydravion avec lequel il est possible de s’amuser à faire des loopings ou de se crasher. Bref un monde où presque tout est permis dès les débuts.
Dès 11h45 heure française, mois d’une demi-heure donc avant le début des premières diffusions en direct, plus de 650 000 spectateurs de tous les pays attendaient déjà sur la plate-forme Twitch . Et le chiffre n’a cessé de monter pour dépasser le million à midi et les 2,5 millions à 12h40.
« Il y a de fortes chances que Twitch vive son plus grand record d’audience jamais enregistré », glissait au Parisien début novembre Dan Clancy, son PDG. D’après le cabinet spécialisé Sensor Tower, le jeu a été précommandé à plus de quinze millions d’exemplaires partout dans le monde.

articles.chapeau: The Game Awards just leaked Manni L. Perez in GTA 6, by nominating her for best performance, essentially confirming she is playing Lucia.
articles.txt:
A few hours ago, The Game Awards revealed all the nominees for this year’s show, to be held this December 10 in LA’s Peacock Theater.
GTA 6 received an impressive 8 nominations, but Take-Two and Rockstar probably do not appreciate one of those nominations.
In a YouTube video , they nominated Manni L. Perez for Best Performance for GTA 6 . Notably, they did not name what role Manni is playing, but that really doesn’t change things for anyone.
It’s been over a year since the rumor spread that Manni is playing the game’s female deuteragonist, Lucia Caminos. Obviously no one can deny her physical resemblance to the character.
The TGAs also played with fire in another way, as these nominations were announced days before GTA 6 launches. This creates an improper situation where a game can get votes before the public has a chance to play it.
This controversy is clearly and easily avoidable if the TGAs had simply waited a few days, but maybe they were looking for the attention.

articles.chapeau: From Justice's original score to radio stations hosted by Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey, here's a guide to the music of "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
From the sun-soaked synth-pop of Vice City to surfing a sea of radio stations, music has always been an essential part of Rockstar Games' gritty, open-world franchise. And with Grand Theft Auto VI taking players back to Vice City, the sprawling soundtrack is shaping up to be just as ambitious as the game itself.
Rockstar has already revealed a 34-track album featuring artists like Travis Scott, Cardi B, and PinkPantheress, along with an original score composed by the French electronic duo Justice. Meanwhile, the game's fictional radio stations are bringing some familiar voices to the airwaves, including Robyn, Bad Bunny, and Lana Del Rey.
And that's just what we know so far. Ahead of GTA 6 's Nov. 19 release , we're keeping track of every confirmed song, artist, radio station, and celebrity DJ coming to Leonida. Consider this your unofficial guide to the sounds of Vice City.
Rockstar has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , a 34-track collection of original music arriving Nov. 19, the same day as the game.
The album features an eclectic mix of artists and genres , from hip-hop heavyweights Travis Scott and Cardi B to country star Morgan Wallen and Puerto Rican singer Rauw Alejandro. There's even a collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and French producer Etienne de Crécy. And somehow, someway, Morgan Wallen's single is the most-streamed track from the soundtrack on Spotify, with more than 25 million streams. Yung Lean, fight back!
"Sexy Magic" — CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Étienne de Crécy
"Flower in a Hurricane" — Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
"Overtown Lights" — Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper
Fans can listen to the available singles on Rockstar's official GTA 6 music website , where the album is also available to pre-save or pre-order on vinyl and CD.
The French electronic duo Justice, consisting of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, is responsible for the original score of Grand Theft Auto VI .
Rockstar confirmed the news on Oct. 15 alongside the game's launch trailer , which features the debut of Justice's new single, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
It's a fitting collaboration for a game returning to Vice City, a fictional playground known for its vibrant nightlife and electronic music. Justice's signature blend of distorted synths, disco, and dance music feels particularly suited to Rockstar's radiant criminal underworld.
The duo previously collaborated with Tame Impala on "Neverender" from their 2024 album Hyperdrama . The song won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2025 Grammys.
Rockstar has also confirmed that an official score album is on the way, although additional details, including its release date and tracklist, have yet to be announced.
The fictional radio stations are one of Grand Theft Auto 's most beloved features, and GTA 6 is bringing some major star power to the airwaves.
On Oct. 8, Rockstar unveiled six radio stations , each with its own musical identity and celebrity hosts. Among the biggest names are Bad Bunny, Robyn, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, and members of Slayer.
Here's a breakdown of the confirmed stations and their hosts :
Bad Bunny is bringing the sounds of Puerto Rico to Vice City. Alongside singer RaiNao, the superstar hosts Cocoteo FM, a station dedicated to modern Latin music, including reggaeton and other Caribbean sounds.
A familiar name for longtime Vice City fans, Flash FM returns with Swedish pop icon Robyn and model Alex Consani behind the microphone. The station promises a steady stream of pop music and dance-floor favorites.
Country music gets its own corner of Leonida with Back Country Radio, hosted by Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey. In perhaps the most unexpected casting choice, Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, also makes an appearance as the station's " roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and airboat captain ."
Afrobeats superstar Burna Boy teams up with DJ and producer Palms Trax for a station spotlighting amapiano, African classics, and other sounds from across the continent.
Metal fans aren't being left out. Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya host The Chamber , a station dedicated to heavy metal.

articles.t: GTA VI : Une immense carte de Leonida aurait fuité, et les joueurs découvrent un monde bien plus vaste que prévu !
articles.chapeau: GTA VI : deux cartes de Leonida auraient fuité et dévoileraient cinq comtés et un immense territoire. Découvrez ce qui est confirmé ou non.
articles.txt:
Facebook Partager sur X(ouvre dans une nouvelle fenêtre) X Partager sur LinkedIn(ouvre dans une nouvelle fenêtre) LinkedIn Partager sur WhatsApp(ouvre dans une nouvelle fenêtre) WhatsApp À l’approche de la sortie de « Grand Theft Auto VI », une nouvelle découverte agite la communauté des joueurs. Deux cartes présentées comme des représentations de Leonida, l’État fictif dans lequel se déroule le jeu de Rockstar Games, circulent sur les réseaux sociaux. Elles montreraient un territoire particulièrement vaste, composé de cinq comtés, de grandes zones rurales, de marécages et de nombreuses routes. Leur origine exacte n’a cependant pas été authentifiée. Plusieurs éléments visuels semblent correspondre à des documents promotionnels officiels, mais cela ne suffit pas à confirmer l’ensemble des informations diffusées. Une chose est certaine : ces images relancent les discussions autour de l’un des jeux vidéo les plus attendus de ces dernières années.
🚨 TWO DIFFERENT #GTAVI LEONIDA MAPS HAVE NOW BEEN REVEALED! 🗺️🌴🔥 We're finally getting a detailed look at TWO map designs from the GTA VI Vice City Collection! 🗺️ LEFT: A colourful geographical map showing Leonida's roads, highways, islands, cities and surrounding waterways.… pic.twitter.com/MZBeaDmzP7
L’univers de « GTA VI » continue de susciter une immense curiosité. À quelques jours de son lancement annoncé, de nouvelles images circulent sur les réseaux sociaux et prétendent révéler une grande partie de la carte du jeu.
Les documents sont au nombre de deux. Le premier présente Leonida sous la forme d’une carte géographique, avec ses routes, ses cours d’eau, ses îles et ses différentes zones naturelles.
Le second adopte une présentation plus illustrée et ferait apparaître cinq comtés. Cette organisation laisse entrevoir un territoire varié, au-delà de la seule ville de Vice City.
Les images ont notamment été relayées par un compte spécialisé dans l’actualité de Rockstar Games. Selon les informations qui les accompagnent, elles pourraient provenir de la « Vice City Collection », un ensemble de produits dérivés commercialisé autour du jeu.
Cette hypothèse explique pourquoi les joueurs leur accordent une certaine attention. La présence supposée de cartes dans un produit officiel renforcerait naturellement leur crédibilité.
Il reste toutefois nécessaire de rappeler que leur provenance exacte n’a pas été établie de manière indépendante. Il serait donc excessif de présenter ces documents comme une révélation officiellement confirmée par Rockstar Games.
Les cartes supposées mettent en évidence plusieurs caractéristiques géographiques qui correspondent à l’univers déjà présenté pour « GTA VI ».
Leonida s’inspire de la Floride, et Vice City constitue l’une de ses principales destinations. Les nouvelles images suggèrent que l’exploration pourrait s’étendre bien au-delà de cet environnement urbain.
De vastes zones rurales apparaissent au nord et à l’ouest. Des marécages seraient également présents dans le sud, tandis que plusieurs réseaux routiers relieraient les différents secteurs.
Les cartes montrent aussi des îles, des voies d’eau et des infrastructures de transport. Un grand aéroport serait notamment situé au sud-ouest de Vice City.
Ces éléments donnent l’impression d’un territoire conçu pour proposer des environnements très différents, entre ville, campagne, zones humides et littoral.
La variété géographique pourrait avoir une influence importante sur l’expérience de jeu. Dans la série Grand Theft Auto, les déplacements et la découverte du monde ouvert occupent une place centrale.
Un territoire plus diversifié permettrait potentiellement de multiplier les situations, les missions et les activités. Il s’agit toutefois d’une projection sur les possibilités du jeu, et non d’une confirmation du contenu de ses missions.

articles.t: GTA 6 Story Length Leak: 50 Hours To Finish Jason and Lucia's Campaign, 200 If You Want It All
articles.chapeau: Clear your calendar, GTA 6 is coming! According to a new review leak, GTA 6's story length comes in at around 50 hours if you stick to the main missions and ski
articles.txt:
Copied Clear your calendar, GTA 6 is coming! According to a new review leak, GTA 6's story length comes in at around 50 hours if you stick to the main missions and skip the side activities. That’s how long it reportedly takes to get through Jason and Lucia’s campaign. Trophy hunters, though, will need a lot more time. The PS5 platinum trophy reportedly needs around 200 hours, and some of that will be spent tracking down wildlife.
The estimate comes from Tom Henderson of Insider Gaming , based on impressions from media members who are reviewing the game ahead of release. He says the campaign has 100 missions spread across five chapters.
Fifty hours might sound short next to an earlier figure. Rockstar North co-lead Rob Nelson told The New York Times that his playthrough took around 80 hours, but that included optional quests in an open world full of distractions.
For comparison, GTA 5’s single-player campaign ran about 32 hours, while Red Dead Redemption 2 also landed around the 50-hour mark. GTA 6’s map, covering Vice City and its surrounding areas, is reportedly much bigger than either. One reason the story may not run longer is that crossing it in a supercar is much faster than doing it on horseback.
Completionists should plan for roughly 200 hours to earn the platinum on PS5. An earlier datamine found 55 PS5 trophies, including the platinum, and Henderson hints at a rare mythic achievement on Xbox, which would give Xbox players the same total.
There’s also a wildlife challenge. Like Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA 6 reportedly asks players to find and photograph 170 different animals across Leonida.
Every objective at launch is reportedly single-player or story-based. There’s no word yet on when a new GTA Online might arrive, but the launch build does contain code related to multiplayer modes.

articles.t: GTA 6's 34-track soundtrack lineup, with Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa, Playboi Carti and JENNIE, leaked through photos of vinyl copies sold before the game's 19 November launch - Make Tech Easier
articles.chapeau: Photos of vinyl copies sold early showed GTA 6's 34-song soundtrack lineup, including new tracks from Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa and Playboi Carti. Billboard and Rolling Stone sources confirmed the list; the album date is disputed.
articles.txt:
Practical fixes for the tech you already own. Free, a few times a week.
Photos of vinyl copies of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album that were sold ahead of schedule put the record’s full 34-song tracklist online over the weekend of 14 and 15 November, days before Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on 19 November. The music itself did not leak. What circulated was the printed 34-song tracklist, which named more than 20 songs Rockstar Games had not announced.
Among the previously unannounced titles are “Crazy for You” by Lana Del Rey, “Go Easy” by Dua Lipa, “Ahh Yea” by Playboi Carti and “Power Trip” by JENNIE, alongside tracks from Burna Boy, Gunna, Young Thug, Camila Cabello, Arca, Rina Sawayama, Kali Uchis and Omar Apollo.
Billboard ‘s Mitchell Peters wrote that “photos and videos of the vinyl edition of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album have surfaced on social media in recent days, revealing its full 34-song tracklist across two records,” and added that “sources close to the project have confirmed the tracklist to Billboard.” Rolling Stone ‘s Daniel Kreps described the same chain of events, saying the list “leaked this weekend when images of the (prematurely sold) vinyl release appeared online,” and that sources confirmed the tracklist to Rolling Stone as well.
USA Today ‘s Greta Cross said that as of 16 November, Rockstar Games had announced 10 of the album’s tracks, and that photos of the prematurely sold vinyl showed the remainder of the lineup. The 10 already public titles, per USA Today, were “That’s It” by Yung Lean featuring Future and Metro Boomin, “RHYNO” by Travis Scott, “Sexy Magic” by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Étienne de Crécy, “Flower in a Hurricane” by Justice featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, “Last Thing You Need” by Morgan Wallen, “Suzuki” by Fuerza Regida, “Macacoa 2000” by Rauw Alejandro, “Don’t Chart” by Cardi B, “Blood In Your Eyes” by Tove Lo and “Bright Lights, Big City” by Keith Richards. USA Today said it reached out to Rockstar for confirmation on 16 November; that piece does not report a response. Billboard noted that several of the songs are already on streaming services, and Rolling Stone counted the Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Keith Richards and Justice tracks among the cuts released before the leak.
Billboard said the album was announced in September by Atlantic Records and Rockstar Games. Speaking to Rolling Stone, Lana Del Rey said, “One of the coolest things about this is the fact that the first time some of our family got to LA they actually knew the roads because of playing the game,” adding, “On so many different levels this is super special and a privilege. Can’t wait to get into the game and start playing.”
The two outlets that confirmed the tracklist do not agree on when the album itself lands. Billboard said Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is set to arrive on 19 November, the same day the game launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rolling Stone said the album will arrive on Friday, 20 November, a day after the game drops digitally. USA Today, for its part, lists shipping rather than streaming: a standard two-record set at $49.98 and an exclusive pressing of two transparent magenta records with blue splatter at the same $49.98, with both vinyl editions shipping on 20 November. A ship date is not necessarily a street date.
The album is also distinct from the game’s original score, which is credited to Justice. USA Today, citing the Rockstar Games website, said the score is due on 11 December across major streaming services, CD and vinyl, with physical formats listed as a triple crystal-clear vinyl at $49.99 and a double CD at $19. USA Today said two score singles were already streaming as of 16 November: “Pusher” by Justice featuring Gesaffelstein, and “Flower in a Hurricane,” which the same piece also lists among the 10 announced album tracks.
This is the lineup as published by Billboard on 14 November after sources close to the project confirmed it, in Billboard’s order, with Billboard’s titles and credits.
The game arrives on 19 November for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with unlock times at midnight local across regions. Make Tech Easier has covered the release date, pricing and preload details separately, and a 24-hour YouTube stream is also planned from midnight ET on launch day.

articles.t: GTA 6 Hacker Arion Kurtaj Pleads Guilty to Rockstar Breach - Daily Voice Of Asia
articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj, 21, pleaded guilty in London to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking 90 GTA 6 clips, days before the game's November 19 launch.
articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 leak of Grand Theft Auto VI footage, has pleaded guilty to breaking into Rockstar Games, days before the game's release.
The 21-year-old from Oxford entered his pleas at Woolwich Crown Court in London on Monday, November 16, after being found fit to stand trial.
He admitted six counts, including hacking Rockstar Games and taking 90 gameplay clips from GTA 6, which he then put online.
He also admitted other offenses he committed as a teenager as part of the Lapsus$ hacking group, involving Uber, Revolut and BT/EE.
Kurtaj hacked Rockstar in 2022 while on bail for other attacks.
Rockstar has said the breach cost it $5 million to recover from, along with thousands of hours of staff time.
He is due to be sentenced at the same court on November 23, according to prosecutors.

articles.t: Xbox reportedly warns against GTA 6 New Zealand trick for early release date unlock

Xbox fans can change their region in console settings, while the process is more difficult for PS5 supporters. Content creator Colt Eastwood also reports a “kinda popular Xbox employee” noted the risks introduced by the unlock time trick. GTA 6 Xbox and PS5 versions officially go live at midnight local time on November 19th. Without the workaround, U.S. West Coast residents would have to wait an additional 21 hours. Gamers will have to decide whether the advantage is worth an unlikely punishment.
Some PlayStation console owners have labored to speed up the GTA 6 release date. More complicated than modifying settings, it requires opening a New Zealand-based PSN account . Then, buyers need to purchase the game with a local gift card.

articles.t: Rockstar Games Hacker Pleads Guilty: GTA 6 Leak and Cross-Border Cyber Law
articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj, the Rockstar Games hacker responsible for the GTA 6 leak, pleaded guilty to multiple offenses. His case raises important questions about the Lapsus$ hacking group, criminal responsibility, UK computer misuse legislation, and international cooperation in cross-border cybercrime investigations.
articles.txt:
The Rockstar Games hacker responsible for leaking unreleased footage of Grand Theft Auto VI has pleaded guilty to a series of cybercrime offenses in the United Kingdom. On November 16, 2026, Arion Kurtaj, a 21-year-old British hacker associated with the Lapsus$ cybercrime group, admitted six charges arising from attacks involving major technology and telecommunications companies. His guilty pleas marked a significant development in a prosecution that had previously been complicated by questions concerning his fitness to stand trial.
Kurtaj became internationally known in September 2022 after obtaining and publishing approximately 90 development videos from Grand Theft Auto VI , one of the video game industry's most commercially significant projects. The incident exposed confidential material belonging to Rockstar Games and generated substantial attention because of the scale of the disclosure and the hacker's subsequent threat to release the game's source code.
The Rockstar incident was part of a wider pattern of cyberattacks involving companies such as Uber, Revolut, and BT/EE. Although the affected businesses operated internationally, the proceedings against Kurtaj took place in England, raising questions about how states investigate and prosecute cybercrime when offenders, victims, computer systems, and digital evidence are located in different jurisdictions.
The case illustrates a fundamental feature of modern cybercrime law: an attack may cross national borders almost instantaneously, but criminal jurisdiction and investigative powers remain subject to domestic legislation and international legal constraints. Understanding the guilty pleas requires examining the earlier British proceedings, the Computer Misuse Act 1990, the potential application of American federal law, international cooperation under the Budapest Convention, and the legal conditions governing extradition.
The Crown Prosecution Service confirmed on November 16, 2026, that Arion Kurtaj had pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to six offenses. The prosecution concerned unauthorized access to computer systems, interference with digital infrastructure, fraud, and a separate offense involving possession of a mobile phone in prison.
The announcement established criminal admissions that were distinct from the findings reached during earlier proceedings in 2023. It also identified the principal companies affected by Kurtaj's activities and described the digital evidence used by investigators to connect his online identities with particular attacks.
The guilty pleas do not mean that every allegation associated with Lapsus$ was separately admitted by Kurtaj. The legal significance of the proceedings depends on the specific offenses identified by prosecutors, rather than the broader public reputation of the hacking group or every incident attributed to its members.
According to the Crown Prosecution Service, Kurtaj admitted three offenses under Section 3(1) of the Computer Misuse Act 1990, concerning unauthorized acts intended to impair, or carried out recklessly as to impairing, the operation of computers. He also pleaded guilty to one fraud offense under Section 1 of the Fraud Act 2006 and one offense under Section 2(1)(b) of the Computer Misuse Act involving unauthorized access with intent to commit or facilitate further offenses.
The sixth guilty plea concerned possession of an unauthorized mobile phone in prison in March 2026. Prosecutors stated that Kurtaj used the device to send a mocking message to the British emergency telephone number, 999. This offense was separate from the corporate cyberattacks, although it formed part of the criminal proceedings concluded by the guilty pleas.
The prosecution described the hacking activity as involving several major companies, but its public announcement did not assign every individual charge to a particular victim or disclose the complete factual basis for each count. Consequently, it would be inaccurate to suggest that Kurtaj pleaded guilty to a distinct offense for every company named in the announcement.
As of November 17, 2026, sentencing remained pending, with the hearing scheduled for November 23. The guilty pleas established criminal responsibility for the admitted offenses, but the sentence and any judicial findings made specifically for sentencing had not yet been determined.

articles.t: GTA 6 Soundtrack Tracklist Leak: 34 Songs, Lana Del Rey and Dua Lipa and more
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's leaked 34-song album tracklist features Lana Del Rey and Dua Lipa. Rolling Stone sources backed the leak, but Rockstar has not unveiled the full list.

Sometimes, all it takes is a familiar melody to bring back memories of a city, an adventure, or a particular moment in Grand Theft Auto. From the neon-soaked streets of GTA: Vice City to the unmistakable hip-hop atmosphere of GTA: San Andreas , music has always been woven into the franchise's identity, often staying with players long after the credits roll. Now, with GTA 6 bringing us back to Vice City, a leaked 34-song album tracklist has given fans another reason to get excited, especially with Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa, and several other major artists reportedly joining the lineup.
Created in partnership with Atlantic Records, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is an official 34-track collection of original music, announced for release alongside the game on November 19, 2026. Rockstar had already unveiled 10 songs, but most of the lineup and the complete running order remained a mystery.
That secrecy was unexpectedly broken on November 14, when images of the back cover of a reportedly early-sold vinyl copy began circulating online, revealing all 34 tracks. Sources speaking to Rolling Stone subsequently corroborated the list, although Rockstar itself has yet to make the complete tracklist official.
Given how deeply music is embedded in Grand Theft Auto's DNA, the attention surrounding the leak is hardly surprising. And while 34 songs make for a substantial album, the real attraction lies in the remarkable mix of artists, genres, and generations brought together for the project.

The most interesting thing about this lineup isn't simply the star power. It's how many different musical worlds seem to meet in one place. Lana Del Rey's nostalgic, cinematic approach to pop offers a striking contrast to Dua Lipa's infectious dance-pop energy. Artists such as Zara Larsson, JENNIE, and Camila Cabello bring further contemporary pop influences, while Travis Scott, Playboi Carti, and Cardi B represent the album's hip-hop presence. Latin music is also well represented, with names including Rauw Alejandro and Kali Uchis.
Justice might be one of the most intriguing additions. The French electronic duo appear on two tracks, collaborating with artists as diverse as Michael McDonald, Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. It's an unusual combination of musical backgrounds that makes the album feel like something more ambitious than a collection of celebrity appearances.
For me, that's where the real excitement begins. Grand Theft Auto has always had a talent for bringing seemingly unrelated sounds together and making them feel perfectly at home within the same virtual world. We haven't heard the full album yet, so judging its overall quality would be premature.
